name: shadow-mcp
description: Search and read the meetings Shadow saves as Markdown on your Mac: notes, transcripts, action items and people. Read-only.
long_description: Shadow is a Mac meeting-notes app that saves every meeting as Markdown in a folder you own. This extension gives Claude six read-only tools over that folder: list meetings, search titles, notes and transcripts, read a meeting's notes, read its transcript, list action items, and look up a person. It runs on your Mac, needs no account, makes no network requests and never changes your files. Requires the Shadow Mac app.

vault.title: Shadow Vault folder
vault.description: The folder shown in Shadow under Settings → Meeting → Vault location.

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.description: List meetings, newest first, by date range or attendee.

tools.name: search_meetings
tools.description: Find meetings by words in titles, notes and transcripts.

tools.name: get_meeting
tools.description: Read one meeting: details, attendees and notes.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Read a meeting's transcript, with speakers and times.

tools.name: list_action_items
tools.description: Collect the Action Items sections of meeting notes.

tools.name: find_person
tools.description: Find a person and the meetings they attended.
